site.name: Areeb Khan
site.description: Areeb Khan is a full-stack software engineer building React, React Native and TypeScript products from scratch, from procurement platforms to supply-chain traceability.

personalInfo.name: Areeb Khan
personalInfo.headline: React · React Native · TypeScript · Node.js
personalInfo.valueProposition: I take web and mobile products from a blank repo to production, then build the shared code, logging and review habits that keep teams shipping fast.
personalInfo.summary: Software engineer since 2019 with a speciality in React. I have led greenfield builds for a restaurant procurement platform, a social-media marketing platform and a blockchain farm-to-fork traceability solution that has given 5M+ products a unique identity.

achievements: Shipped Reeco's mobile app from an empty repo to stable **Android** and **iOS** releases, as measured by [metric: installs / active users], by owning the **React Native** build end-to-end and then guiding the team as it added new modules.
Made the company website editable without engineering help, as measured by [metric: e.g. content-change turnaround], by rebuilding the site and proposing and integrating a **headless CMS**.
Kept code quality consistent across Reeco's repositories, as measured by [metric: e.g. PRs reviewed per month], by running regular **pull-request reviews**.

Launched SuperTokens' public **JWT** Encoder / Decoder, supporting 6 signing algorithms (**HS256**, **HS384**, **HS512**, **ES256**, **RS256**, **PS256**), by building the module with signature-key validity checks.

Improved performance of the user-management dashboard and company website, as measured by [metric: e.g. Lighthouse / load time], by maintaining the dashboard and **front-end SDKs** and fixing UI bugs.
Brought legacy code up to the latest SDK version and added theming to the sign-up page, as measured by [metric], by refactoring with the UI/UX team to integrate the new design elements.
Improved sign-up security and user experience, as measured by [metric], by adding **session-based authentication** to the sign-up flow of the **Node.js** back-end SDK.

Delivered the BeTagged social-media marketing web app from scratch, as measured by [metric: e.g. launch scope / users], by leading its **TypeScript** + **React** build and mentoring developers through daily code reviews.
Eliminated duplicated business logic between web and mobile, as measured by [metric: e.g. % shared code], by setting up and managing a **Lerna** monorepo and co-leading the shared-code development.
Created the logging blueprint now reused by other projects in the organisation, by moving logging from platform-specific to a single cross-platform setup with **Segment** and **Sentry**.

Reduced wait times across Reeco's three procurement apps (Back Office, Seller, Buyer), as measured by [metric: e.g. perceived latency], by implementing optimistic updates and response caching with **TanStack Query**.
Improved component reuse across those three apps, as measured by [metric: e.g. shared components], by contributing flexible components to a **Storybook** component library.

workExperience.role: Full Stack / Lead Front End Developer
achievements: Increased daily label-printing throughput by more than 60%, by architecting a **Node.js** print driver and dashboard (**MongoDB**, **Express**, **Puppeteer**) that automated dynamic QR-code labels and replaced proprietary software.

Gave unique traceability to 5M+ end products, integrated into 3+ supply chains and winning 1st prize at the inaugural Inspiring Futures event (UAE), by co-leading development of the blockchain-enabled farm-to-fork traceability solution QRiosity.
Delivered client-specific traceability experiences, as measured by 5+ trace apps shipped, by designing them in **Adobe XD** and building them in **React**.
Supported inventory, invoicing and throughput estimation for enterprises, as measured by [metric], by leading front-end development of the Invento ERP with **React**, **Redux** and **Ant Design**.
Reached ~10K impressions per month for Sahyadri Farms, India's leading Farmer-Producer Organisation, by developing and co-designing its corporate website.

Put a traceability module in the hands of less tech-savvy farmers in Maharashtra, as measured by [metric: e.g. farmers onboarded], by building a **PWA** and a **React Native** Android app with **i18n** support.
Trained 30+ interns in **React**, by running hands-on bootcamps from fundamentals to advanced concepts.

Launched DhammaEdicts, a web app storing the sacred Buddhist Tripitaka texts on a blockchain, inaugurated by the Dalai Lama at the Global Buddhist Congregation 2019, by designing and building it with **React**, **Redux**, **Node.js** and **MongoDB**.
Secured access to the platform, as measured by [metric], by co-implementing authentication and authorisation with **JWT**.
Enabled farmers to reach out for skill training and incubation, as measured by [metric], by designing and developing the website for the HortiSquare farmer-outreach programme.
Translated theoretical solutions for real-world problems into software, by working alongside tech entrepreneurs through team exercises, presentations and seminars.
Let patients book appointments and practitioners manage reports for an acupressure practice, as measured by [metric], by designing and co-developing an **Android** app and the client's website.
